name: r1-ef-bulk-tf32-stream-b16
author: solx-loop
description: Under the harness protocol the S-band floor is not 53 us (H16). The dirty-L2 write-back is paid because plain reads allocate W lines that evict the 126 MB of dirty zero lines. Reads tagged L2 evict_first (createpolicy, also as a cp.async.bulk cache hint) replace each other, so the write-back falls outside the timed window. Reads-only stream: 45.9 us plain vs 39.9 us evict_first (CUPTI, harness flush). A TF32 mma.sync kernel fed by evict_first 2 KB bulk copies reaches 41.6 / 43.6 us at B=5/16. Ab
